reason: Holds. ScreenerPresets.apply calls only setUniverse/setCriteria/setCombinator('and') before runScreener. setCriteria is a bare set({criteria}) and does not clear group, advanced or formula, while runScreener sends the pruned nested tree, which takes precedence, and always attaches the trimmed formula. A preset click from Nested mode therefore runs the old tree plus the old formula under the preset's name. resetCriteria and applyFilters both clear these fields, so the preset path is the inconsistent one.
